children: Comcast reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $29.3 billion, down 6.1% from a year earlier, while net income rose 3.5% to $3.36 billion and diluted EPS increased 7.8% to $0.97. Revenue reflected the Versant separation, the Germany Sky sale and declines in Connectivity, partly offset by Content & Experiences.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per common share attributable to Comcast Corporation shareholders”.
Residential revenue declined 3.5% as broadband and video customers fell. Wireless lines grew to 10.6 million, while Business Services revenue increased 2.7%.
Media revenue rose 13%, supported by the FIFA World Cup. Peacock had 48 million paid subscribers, up from 41 million a year earlier.
Studios EBITDA increased 18.6% on stronger theatrical results, while Theme Parks revenue declined 4.4% amid lower admissions and promotions.
Versant separated on January 2, 2026. Comcast plans an NBCUniversal and Sky spin-off for mid-2027, subject to conditions.
